info.name: EventMitra - Owner API
info.description: Signup, test OTP verification, login/logout, and password recovery. Signup first creates a pending owner; names must be unique. Test OTP is 1111 and real email/SMS delivery is not connected. OTPs are disabled in production. Reset uses a verified password-reset token, not a general verification token. Run signup once; use existing-account auth folders separately afterward. Bank account add/list/get and default-only update are included; apply migration 014 and fill bank_* environment fields. Migration 015 venue/configuration APIs are included in a separate folder; set venue_name and admin venue_owner_id. Slots, decorations, meals and prices now use a single POST save endpoint with an optional record ID for updates. Null venue child record IDs create new rows; populated IDs update existing rows. Separate child PUT routes are removed. Three venue-scoped price dropdowns provide slot, decoration and meal options.

item.description: Run this folder for this login method. The last request expects 401 after logout. Do not run the name folder for a shared owner name.

request.description: Use an existing pending or verified owner with an app-generated scrypt-v1 password hash. Owner names may contain spaces and are unique after case/whitespace normalization.
The Postman cookie jar sends the owner cookie automatically. Admin cookies cannot authenticate this endpoint.
No body. Revokes only the current owner session. Also clears expired/invalid owner cookies. Repeated logout returns 200.

09 - My venues and configuration (owner)
item.description: Apply migration 015. Run separately with existing credentials. Set venue_name; admin also selects venue_owner_id from the dropdown. Creates a venue, two slots, singleton amenities, decoration, two meals and linked prices. Owner edits to approved venues require review. Admin actions use venue_management module grants.
